name: Decimal expansion of Sum_{n >= 1} sigma_1(n)/n!.
comment: Problem No. 45 from P. Erdős (see the 1963 link). The problem is "is Sum_{n >= 1} sigma_k(n)/n! an irrational number where sigma_k(n) is the sum of the k-th power of divisors of n?" This property has been proved with k = 1 and 2 (see Breusch link for the proof).
reference: R. K. Guy, Unsolved Problems in Number Theory, Springer, 1st edition, 1981. See section B14.
link: Paul Erdős, Some unsolved problems, Publ. Inst. Hung. Acad. Sci. 6 (1961), 221-259.
